records.name: A Debilitating Sickness

records.name: Nightstalker Clean Up, Isle 2...

records.name: An Unusual Patron
records.objectives_text: Use the Gift of Naias near the Altar of Naias to summon the water elemental Naias. Defeat him and return to Nemeth Hawkeye at Grom'gol Base Camp with the Heart of Naias.

records.name: Falcon Watch

records.objectives_text: Daedal wants you to travel south and seek out the people that the injured creature mentioned.

records.objectives_text: Find the Nazzivus Monument in Nazzivian and retrieve a Nazzivus Monument Glyph. Return to Vindicator Aalesia in Blood Watch when you have one of the glyphs.

wiki.page: On the Wings of a Hippogryph

records.name: Hippogryph Master Stephanos
records.objectives_text: Find Stephanos outside the Exodar and purchase a hippogryph ride back to Azure Watch.

records.objectives_text: Speak with Stephanos to purchase a hippogryph ride back to Azure Watch. Once you have arrived, deliver Nurguni's Supplies to Caregiver Chellan.

records.name: Bandits!
records.objectives_text: Take the Blood Elf Communication to Exarch Menelaous at Azure Watch.

records.objectives_text: Bring the Letter from Lor'themar Theron to Lady Sylvanas Windrunner in Undercity, the Forsaken capital in Tirisfal Glades.

records.objectives_text: Obtain Medivh's Journal and return to Kamsis at the Guardian's Library in Karazhan.

records.objectives_text: Vindicator Boros at Blood Watch wants you to bring him 10 Irradiated Crystal Shards.

records.objectives_text: Go to the Master's Terrace in Karazhan and touch the Blackened Urn to summon Nightbane. Retrieve the :Faint Arcane Essence from Nightbane's corpse and bring it to Archmage Alturus.

records.objectives_text: Go to the Master's Terrace in Karazhan and read Medivh's Journal. Return to Archmage Alturus with Medivh's Journal after completing this task.

records.objectives_text: Tracker Lyceon at Blood Watch wants you to kill 10 Royal Blue Flutterers.

records.objectives_text: Maatparm at Blood Watch wants 2 Ysera's Tears.

records.objectives_text: Kessel at Kessel's Crossing wants you to warn High Chief Stillpine at Stillpine Hold, Exarch Menelaous at Azure Watch and Admiral Odesyus at Odesyus' Landing of the imminent blood elf invasion. Return to Kessel when you complete this task. You have 15 minutes. (Be sure to keep it out of water.)

records.name: Declaration of Power
records.objectives_text: Kessel at Kessel's Crossing on Bloodmyst Isle wants you to kill Lord Xiz at Wrathscale Lair and drive the Draenei Banner through his dead body.

records.objectives_text: Release Princess Stillpine from her cage and then speak with Stillpine Ambassador Olorg at Blood Watch. You must kill High Chief Bristlelimb for the key that opens the cage.

records.objectives_text: Speak with Exarch Admetius at Blood Watch.

records.objectives_text: Kill 8 Myst Spinners, 8 Myst Leechers and their leader, Zarakh. Return to Achelus at Blood Watch when the task is complete.

records.objectives_text: Speak with Jesthenis Sunstriker - the Paladin class trainer - inside the Sunspire on Sunstrider Isle.

objectives.text: Ark of Ssslith safely returned to Sporeggar
Return to Gzhun'tt at Sporeggar in Zangarmarsh.
